top.line: A design proposal for PrompTugal.news as a ground-up newsroom: every story has an address and climbs with its proof.
top.para: Mocked up from the live data of 19 local editions.

in-short.line: News starts local; the data exists; addresses and climbs; mockups; names; a locality layer.

why.line: National news starts regionally, regional news in a town, so build the newsroom from the ground up.
why.para: One agent per place already keeps a signed file.

data.line: 19 editions, 116 sourced stories, 182 organisations, 23 events, 16 connections, 166 gaps.
data.para: Thin towns are fine if the design connects them.

climb.line: ALGAR's AI tool is filed in Almancil and climbs to Loulé, the pilot towns, the region and Portugal.
climb.para: Each step is a sourced connection back to the address.

front.line: A national front page with no national desk, assembled from the local files and their connections.
front.para: A live strip, addresses and climbs, the towns side by side.

region.line: The regional page is a map: towns sized by their files, borders, and sourced connections.
region.para: Plus events and how to start a company.

town.line: Each town edition keeps its agent's voice, its stories, its map, its neighbours and its gaps.

story.line: The story page adds a rail: the address, how it climbed, its sources and the signing agent.

proof.line: Behind every page, a chain of custody from local source to front page, designed in.

names.line: Three names: local first, proven up (recommended); PrompTugal Raiz; The Address.

principles.line: Address, proof, gaps, altitude, now then depth, distance to the beat.

locality.line: The site needs a locality layer: parishes, municipalities, regions and neighbours.
locality.para: So thin towns lean on the places around them.

limits.line: Mockups, real content except sample weather, a hand-drawn schematic map, names undecided.

sources.line: The by-place files, the Loulé agent's ALGAR story, and earlier articles.
